shellkeep servers:
Usage: shellkeep servers [options] [command]

Your SSH server profiles

Options:
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]       List your server profiles
  test [options] <id>  Test the SSH connection of a server profile (exit 1 on
                       failure)
  help [command]       display help for command
shellkeep servers list:
Usage: shellkeep servers list [options]

List your server profiles

Options:
  --tag <tag>  only profiles carrying this tag
  --json       print JSON instead of a table
  -h, --help   display help for command
shellkeep servers test:
Usage: shellkeep servers test [options] <id>

Test the SSH connection of a server profile (exit 1 on failure)

Arguments:
  id          server profile id

Options:
  --json      print JSON instead of text
  -h, --help  display help for command
shellkeep sessions:
Usage: shellkeep sessions [options] [command]

Your terminal sessions

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]  List your terminal sessions
  attach <id>     Attach this terminal to a session (Ctrl-] then d detaches and
                  leaves it running)
  help [command]  display help for command
shellkeep sessions list:
Usage: shellkeep sessions list [options]

List your terminal sessions

Options:
  --status <status>  filter by status (active, detached, terminated, all)
  --json             print JSON instead of a table
  -h, --help         display help for command
shellkeep sessions attach:
Usage: shellkeep sessions attach [options] <id>

Attach this terminal to a session (Ctrl-] then d detaches and leaves it running)

Arguments:
  id          session id (see `sessions list`)

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
